channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Billionaire's family gave $50M job to Trump's ex-lawyer for pardon: Report
item.description: A report indicates that a Venezuelan billionaire's family secured a pardon from former President Donald Trump after arranging a $50 million job for his ex-attorney, Alina Habba. The New York Times and The Independent reported on the… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: French Trials Follow Looting Incidents
item.description: Dozens of individuals arrested during looting incidents in France are facing trials. Reports indicate that the legal proceedings have involved excuses and hasty procedures. The nature of these incidents and the subsequent trials have drawn… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: French Police Use New Stun Grenades on Protesters, Injuring Some
item.description: French police have continued to use new stun grenades during protests, resulting in injuries to demonstrators. The Economist noted that the government faces challenges in meeting the protesters' demands. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Student Jailed for Minimum 28 Years for Housemate's Murder
item.description: A university student has been jailed for a minimum of 28 years for the murder of his housemate. The student admitted to the killing, which involved stabbing the victim 30 times in what was described as a 'cold-blooded execution'. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Accused of Killing Wife After Claiming ICE Abduction
item.description: Authorities in California allege that a man, who had previously claimed Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents abducted his wife, is now accused of killing her. The Independent reported that the man made the claim about ICE… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Beijing Defends Cuba's Raul Castro Amid Florida Murder Warrant
item.description: Beijing has defended former Cuban leader Raul Castro following the issuance of a murder warrant against him in Florida. Cuban American lawmakers have welcomed the warrant and pledged continued efforts for Cuba's freedom. The specific… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: DOJ Watchdog Declines Reflecting Pool Case Investigation
item.description: The Justice Department's Office of the Inspector General (OIG) has declined to investigate alleged misconduct in the Reflecting Pool vandalism case, according to lawyers involved. This decision means the OIG will not probe the handling of… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Supreme Court Rejects Trump Policy on Transgender Inmate Treatment
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court has rejected a bid by the Trump administration to impose curbs on certain medical treatments for transgender inmates. The court's brief order did not specify its legal reasoning for the rejection. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Ilhan Omar's Home Searched by US Authorities; Trump Comments
item.description: US authorities conducted a search of Representative Ilhan Omar's Washington D.C. home, during which a DNA sample was reportedly seized. Following the search, former President Donald Trump stated that Omar could be jailed and deported. Omar… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: High Court Sets Aside Order on Foreign Travel Details
item.description: The Delhi High Court has set aside an order that directed the disclosure of details regarding the foreign travel of Prime Ministers Narendra Modi and Manmohan Singh. The Central Information Commission (CIC) had previously ordered the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Australia Sues Meta Over Child Social Media Addiction Claims
item.description: Australia has filed a lawsuit against Meta Platforms, alleging the company kept children addicted to social media. The lawsuit was filed amid rising tensions between Australia and Big Tech companies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Navy Tests Rafale Marine Jets for INS Vikrant Aircraft Carrier
item.description: The Indian Navy has begun flight trials for the Rafale Marine fighter jets in Goa, intended for deployment on the INS Vikrant aircraft carrier. A deal for 26 of these aircraft was finalized in 2025, with deliveries expected to commence… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Ladakh High Court Bench Starts Regular Hearings in Leh
item.description: The High Court Bench in Ladakh has commenced regular hearings in Leh. This bench is situated at the highest altitude in India. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: HDFC Bank Investigates Alleged Leak of Business Information
item.description: HDFC Bank has initiated an internal review following allegations of a leak of confidential business information. The bank confirmed that an internal probe is underway to investigate the matter. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Curfew in Washim After Durga Procession Clashes Over Gulal
item.description: Curfew was imposed in Washim, Maharashtra, following clashes that erupted during a Durga procession on Vijaya Dashami. The conflict reportedly began over the throwing of gulal (colored powder) between two groups, leading to stone-pelting… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: SBI Data Leak Linked to Dark Web Sales, Experts Warn
item.description: Reports indicate a significant data leak affecting millions of SBI customers, with personal information allegedly appearing on the dark web. Experts explain how customer data is stolen, sold on the dark web, and subsequently used for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ankita Bhandari Case: CBI Seeks Polygraph, Narco Test for Urmila Sanwar
item.description: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has sent a notice to actress Urmila Sanwar, seeking to conduct a polygraph and narco-analysis test in connection with the Ankita Bhandari murder case. The CBI aims to uncover any "VIP angle" in the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Dragged on Car Roof, Crushed to Death in Kanpur
item.description: In Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, a 37-year-old man was killed after his hands' fingers were allegedly trapped in car windows, and he was then tied to the car's roof and dragged for approximately 1.5 kilometers. Subsequently, he was thrown onto… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Bengaluru Explosion Injures Two Workers
item.description: An explosion occurred at an under-construction building in Bengaluru, injuring two workers. One report states a device disguised as a torch exploded, causing a worker to lose two fingers. Another report describes the object as a mystery… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Woman Dies After Amusement Ride Mishap at Delhi Dussehra Mela
item.description: A 27-year-old woman died after falling from an amusement ride at a Dussehra Mela in Delhi's Vikaspuri. She passed away while undergoing treatment at a hospital. The venue reportedly violated an 11 pm deadline. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Student Found Dead in Mumbai Hostel, Suspected Suicide Under Investigation
item.description: A student was found dead in a hostel room on the Matunga campus of the Institute of Chemical Technology (ICT) in Mumbai. The incident is believed to have occurred between 10 pm and midnight. Police are investigating the death as a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Landslide Derails Train Locomotive in Kerala, Disrupting Services
item.description: A landslide near Parassala railway station in Kerala's Thiruvananthapuram district caused the locomotive of the Bilaspur-Tirunelveli Express to derail late Wednesday night, disrupting train services. Southern Railway confirmed that all… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: US orders diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attack fears
item.description: The United States has ordered non-emergency embassy staff and their families to leave Saudi Arabia due to escalating Houthi attacks. Drone debris from an attack killed two people, and an Indian national was among those injured. The US is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 8 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian Railways Cancels 16 Trains for Three Months
item.description: Indian Railways has cancelled 16 trains for a period of three months. The railway authority released figures indicating the extent of improvement in train punctuality across the country. Passengers are advised to check the list of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Four Soldiers Die in Training Fire at CFB Wainwright
item.description: Four soldiers died in a fire during a military training exercise at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Wainwright. The incident occurred during a training event, and the cause of the fire is under investigation. The province of Saskatchewan is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: NFL Player Jordan Elliott Released by Titans After Gun Incident
item.description: Tennessee Titans player Jordan Elliott was released by the team after he reportedly pulled a gun following an incident with a teammate during training. The incident led to his subsequent unemployment with the team. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Railways Warn Passengers Against Loud Music, Potential Jail Time
item.description: Indian Railways has issued a warning to passengers against playing loud music or making loud calls on trains, stating that violations could lead to legal action, including a potential jail term of up to six months and a fine of Rs 1,000… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: IPS officer fires AK-47 during Dussehra ritual, sparking safety debate
item.description: An IPS officer in Chhattisgarh fired an AK-47 rifle during a Dussehra ritual, an event that was captured on video and subsequently went viral. The incident has ignited a debate regarding safety protocols and the appropriateness of such… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Global Websites Offline Due to PHP Vulnerability
item.description: Websites worldwide, including government sites in Canada and Europe, were taken offline as a precautionary measure due to a serious vulnerability discovered in the PHP computer language. This language is used to build approximately 70% of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: Punjab CM Mann Claims Detention, Accuses Centre of Humiliation
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was reportedly detained at Delhi Airport for three hours upon his return from France, according to claims by the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP). AAP alleged that officials imposed a penalty of ₹50,000 on Mann… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.title: Australia Extends Ban on KPMG Federal Contracts
item.description: Australia has extended its ban on KPMG from securing federal government contracts until February 2027. The ban was initially imposed due to breaches of confidentiality and misuse of government information. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Nearly $1 Million in Trading Cards Stolen from FedEx Truck
item.description: Approximately $1 million worth of sports and Pokémon trading cards were stolen from a FedEx truck in California. The theft involved two pallets of the valuable collectibles. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: EU Investigates Booking.com for Fraud and Phishing Risks
item.description: European Union regulators have launched an investigation into Booking.com, citing concerns over the accommodation website's handling of fraudulent listings and phishing scams. The European Commission has described the company's approach to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion in New Mexico Data Privacy Case
item.description: A New Mexico court has ordered Meta to pay a $25 billion penalty after a jury found the company misled consumers regarding data privacy. The ruling is linked to allegations stemming from the Cambridge Analytica scandal, concerning the… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 10 · Right 0.

item.title: Russell Brand rape trial: First accuser testifies in court
item.description: A woman has alleged that Russell Brand told her "it's just fun" as he raped her in a hotel room in 1999 during the Labour party conference. The alleged victim recounted the incident to detectives, stating she "felt dirty and sick"… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 7 · Right 1.

item.title: Kashmiri Travellers Alarmed by Bus Attacks in Haryana and Punjab
item.description: Two separate incidents involving attacks on buses carrying Kashmiri travellers have caused alarm. In Haryana, an elderly Kashmiri man was injured when bricks were hurled at a Delhi-Srinagar bus. Subsequently, a similar incident occurred… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 3.

item.title: Indian Swimmer Deported from Japan Over Sexual Misconduct Allegations
item.description: Indian para swimmer Mohammad Shams Alam Shaikh has been deported from Japan following allegations of sexual misconduct. The incident occurred while he was in Japan for the Asian Para Games. He was reportedly detained and subsequently… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Tourist Found Guilty of Animal Cruelty for Flamingo Theft
item.description: A Canadian tourist has been found guilty of animal cruelty in Las Vegas for stealing a flamingo from a hotel exhibit. The bird, named Peachy, was taken from its display. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Minister Rijiju Condemns Racial Abuse of Tripura Youth by Delhi Influencer
item.description: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has condemned a Delhi-based influencer for racially abusing a young man from Tripura, stating there is "no place for hate" and promising a "hard lesson" for the perpetrator. The incident, captured on video, has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Attack on Saudi Airport Kills One, Injures Eight
item.description: An attack on Saudi Arabia's King Fahd International Airport late Wednesday night resulted in one death and eight injuries. The airport sustained damage, and some flights were diverted following the incident. Saudi airports have been… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 2.
